title: M&M: The Chocolate Chain
description: A Local Multiplayer Co-Op puzzle game based on the M&M brand
fullDescription: This was a demo which I developed as part of a group project in which we were tasked with designing a game based on the M&M brand. It is a local multiplayer co-op puzzle game developed in Unity.
skills: Implemented local co-op controls using Unity’s Input Manager
Developed physics-based chain mechanics using Unity’s Physics System
Applied creative problem-solving in game design
Collaborated effectively in a team environment
